verdict.rationale: The evidence documents REST APIs, machine-readable OpenAPI specs, code examples in curl, Node, Python and Go, a gddy CLI, and an MCP server. None of these is an official client SDK library. OpenAPI specs and code samples are developer building blocks, and the CLI and MCP server are separate stories, so no credit transfers here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
